title: [Quality Management] Confirm before finishing on Create Re-inspection
summary: Quality inspections now ask for confirmation before finishing when creating a re-inspection on an open inspection, preventing unintended state changes if the user declines.
key_points: Confirmation dialog moved before any changes occur for open inspections
Answering No leaves the inspection open with no automatic finish
Already finished inspections preserve existing confirmation behavior
Non-interactive callers like APIs remain unaffected
New tests validate both accepted and declined scenarios
quote: The confirmation is now asked before anything changes
